MUST NOT transmit messages with information in the high-order bit of octets'；906–908 'receiving SMTP servers MAY clear the high-order bit or reject the message as invalid'；908–911 'a relay SMTP SHOULD assume that the message content it has received is valid and ... relay it without inspecting that content'；914–915 'Delivery SMTP systems MAY reject such messages, or return them as undeliverable'；915–918 'In the absence of a server-offered extension explicitly permitting it, a sending SMTP system is not permitted to send envelope commands in any character set other than US-ASCII'（陈述式禁止）；918–919 'Receiving systems SHOULD reject such commands, normally using "500 syntax error - invalid character" replies'。第904–905行 'see the next paragraph' 指向下段（跨度外），故 cross=跨句。
